name: Nebaioth
overview: Nebaioth, also spelled Nebajoth, is identified in Scripture as the firstborn son of Ishmael, Abraham's son, establishing him as a significant figure in the genealogy of Ishmael's descendants (Genesis 25:13; 1 Chronicles 1:29). His family connections are highlighted through his sister Bashemath, who became a wife of Esau, illustrating the intertwining of these lineages (Genesis 28:9; 36:3). Prophetic imagery involving Nebaioth appears in Isaiah 60:7, where the rams of Nebaioth are depicted as ministering acceptably on God's altar, symbolizing a future honoring and glorification of God's house. This points to God's sovereign plan to include even the descendants of Ishmael in His redemptive purposes.
